recommendation: Keep this commit as-is; it is a narrow non-substantive source fix that implements the published request without changing the ValueSet code search parameter semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-16858 was a Published/Persuasive vocab change request from the STU3 ballot asking the ValueSet Search Parameters section to add a link from the code token search parameter text to the additional notes on the ValueSet resource.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-16858 was found. Git history shows the code search parameter and the sentence "See additional notes on the ValueSet resource" originated earlier under #13940; the parameter was absent from the R4 branch, matching the Jira comment that it had been removed at the time, and the current source rework later recreated the search parameter bundle with the unlinked sentence.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini and owned by vocab, so source/valueset/bundle-ValueSet-search-params.xml is in current build scope. The current notes file has the valueset.html#search anchor for "Searching for codes in value sets", and no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that would alter the published Jira request.
reconciliation: Changed the active ValueSet-code SearchParameter description from plain text to a Markdown link targeting valueset.html#search, preserving the existing wording and semantics.
source_changes: source/valueset/bundle-ValueSet-search-params.xml: added a Markdown link to valueset.html#search in the ValueSet-code SearchParameter description.
